en: Iyolin - Word from home: something has gone wrong in Bifrost, and the plan to unsettle Trisys has failed.
Daicus - Then we have no choice but to attack Trisys alone. Without the Gaysir army, the assassins of Trisys shouldn't be much of a problem...

Iyolin - The problem is that we have almost no experience of desert warfare. The Trisys army knows the desert well, and Kassim, the 'King of the Desert', is no easy opponent. I've heard he helped the Black Prince and gave our side a great deal of trouble in the last war.
Erich - What magic armor does Trisys have?
Iyolin - Trisys is famous for 'Ra', which Kassim pilots himself, but there are rumours they're building a new model.
Arcia - In any case, please remember there will never be a better chance to strike the Empire than now.
Iyolin - We can't turn back after coming this far. Let's push a little harder and bring down Trisys while we have the chance.
